title: DeepSeek V4 Pro Launches on Silicon Flow: A Million-Level Context Window with Three Levels of Reasoning Intensity, Cache Hit Cost Just $0.44 per Million Tokens

content_html:
DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 is officially launched on SiliconFlow, and it's a Day-0 launch. The core highlights of this update are three numbers and one orientation: a 1M context window, three levels of reasoning intensity (low/medium/high), and a stronger focus on coding, tool calls, and agent workflows. The open-source license remains unchanged, still MIT.

The pricing structure is clear: $1.32 per million input tokens, $3.96 per million output tokens, and only $0.44 for cache-hit tokens. The last figure is truly worth noting—the price of cache-hit tokens being this low means that for Agent workflows that rely heavily on repeated calls and long context inputs, the unit cost calculation in long-text scenarios now has a more concrete anchor point, avoiding budget overruns when handling long contexts.

content_html_zh:
DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813在SiliconFlow上正式发布，这是Day-0发布。 本次更新的核心亮点是三个数字和一个方向：1M上下文窗口、三个级别的推理强度（低/中/高），以及更加关注编码、工具调用和代理工作流程。 开源许可证保持不变，仍然是 MIT。

定价结构很明确：每百万个输入代币 1.32 美元，每百万个输出代币 3.96 美元，缓存命中代币仅为 0.44 美元。 最后一个数字确实值得注意——缓存命中令牌的价格如此之低，意味着对于严重依赖重复调用和长上下文输入的 Agent 工作流程来说，长文本场景中的单位成本计算现在有了更具体的锚点，避免了处理长上下文时的预算超支。
